comparisons.reason: Same source (OC_comments), binary any-comment form and null/empty rules, but the construct differs. Left requires a specific institutional precedent (existing law, policy, court, organization or system) presented as functioning in practice. Right accepts any concrete real-world example (event, case, person, place, study, statistic, historical instance). The right set is materially broader, so a person, event or statistic that is not a functioning institution scores 1 on the right and 0 on the left.
